import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, torture, controller, planlib, probability
bad = 0; n = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 100
for i in range(n):
    rng = random.Random(4242+i)
    c = (torture.tcase(rng) if i%2 else gen.gen_case(rng, J=rng.randint(0,9), S=rng.randint(1,5), F=rng.randint(1,4), G=rng.randint(0,3), tmax=rng.choice([30,300])))
    preds = controller._predict(c['model'], c['windows'], c['flows'])
    thr = probability.window_thresholds(c['stats'], c['windows'])
    Wd = c['windows']; cv = c['class_values']
    value = [Wd[j][6]*cv[preds[j]] for j in range(len(Wd))]
    W = 1+len(Wd)*c['slots'][-1][0]
    ep = planlib.Plan(c['bucket'],c['slots'],c['flows'],c['groups'],Wd,preds,thr,value,W)
    ep.build_arcs(); ep.build_aux()
    idx = ep.ratio_search(); ratio = ep.rset[idx]; low = ep.lowers(ratio); ep.set_lowers(low)
    ep.optimise(low); ep.potentials(low)
    cut = None if ratio>=1 else ep.cut_for(idx)
    ok1 = ep.verify(ratio, low, cut)
    U1, A1, asg1 = ep.utility, ep.age, list(ep.assignment)
    ep.optimise_direct(low)
    ok2 = ep.potentials(low) and ep.verify(ratio, low, cut)
    if not (ok1 and ok2) or (U1, A1) != (ep.utility, ep.age):
        bad += 1
        print('MISMATCH', i, ok1, ok2, (U1,A1), (ep.utility, ep.age), ratio, asg1, ep.assignment)
        if bad > 3: break
print('fallback cross-check cases', n, 'bad', bad)
PYEOF
